| Stage | tidymodels | scikit-learn |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Hold out a test set | `rsample::initial_split()`, `training()`, `testing()` | `train_test_split()` |
| Describe the preprocessing | `recipes::recipe()` plus `step_*()` | `ColumnTransformer` plus transformers |
| Choose the model | `parsnip::logistic_reg()`, `rand_forest()`, `boost_tree()` | `LogisticRegression()`, `RandomForestClassifier()`, `HistGradientBoostingClassifier()` |
| Bind the two together | `workflows::workflow()` | `Pipeline` |
| Estimate it | `fit()` | `.fit()` |
| Use it | `predict()`, `augment()` | `.predict()`, `.predict_proba()` |
| Score it | `yardstick::rmse()`, `roc_auc()`, `metric_set()` | `mean_squared_error`, `roc_auc_score` |
| Resample | `rsample::vfold_cv()` | `KFold`, `StratifiedKFold` |
| Tune | `tune::tune()`, `tune_grid()` | `GridSearchCV`, `RandomizedSearchCV` |
